faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BITS Pilani Jr. Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Jr. Officer position at BITS Pilani is 12th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Jr. Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Fresh CA (Inter) / ICWA (Inter) or M.Com. (or equivalent in Finance/Accounting) with 2-3 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Jr. Officer position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Jr. Officer post ranges from Rs. 8,00,000 to Rs. 10,00,000 per annum.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Jr. Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Jr. Officer position at BITS Pilani.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Jr. Officer position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Jr. Officer position is regular.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the BITS Pilani campus located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for BITS Pilani, Goa campus.

faq.question: Q9. What kind of experience is required for the Jr. Officer role?
faq.answer: The required experience is at least 2-3 years in areas like accounting, sponsored research grants, government-funded projects, PFMS, or project finance.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article by clicking on the provided link for the Official Notification PDF.
